limitations: The fixture is synthetic (seed 7, 120 actions per match) with almost no learnable signal; it verifies the trial machinery, it does not evaluate the model on real data.
The development split is a single match, so per-candidate differences on it are noisy and no narrow win is a real finding.
Family (c) grid choice and family comparison share the development split; the frozen benchmark is the only untouched check.
Family (f) windows may cross a period boundary.
Downstream squad-regret impact is not measured here; that is the U09 remit.

selection.reason: best challenger (e) beats the baseline by 0.003546 mean headline Brier on the development split, clearing the 0.002 margin

promotion.reason: selected challenger (e) beats the baseline by 0.002610 mean headline Brier on the frozen benchmark, but its mean headline Brier skill against the training base rate is -0.090: it still loses to the trivial base-rate predictor, so the win is not a clear measured benefit and nothing is promoted. Confirm on real data first.
